subject: VAT evidence and self-billing for Trento Systems
messages:
From: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@trento-systems.it>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-06T09:12:00+02:00
Subject: Billing details and VAT handling for Redwood subscription

Hi Irene,

Quick question as we're setting up Redwood for a pilot: Trento Systems is an Italian VAT-registered company (VAT: IT01234567890) and the subscription will be used by our Italy entity. Do you charge VAT on Redwood hosted invoices, or do we self-account via the reverse-charge? Our procurement team also needs a formal invoice (PDF) showing the VAT position for audit.

I'm attaching our VAT registration certificate for now (Trento-VAT-Certificate.pdf). If you could confirm what evidence you need from us to apply reverse-charge (VIES check, certificate, PO), that would be great.

Thanks,
Luca Bianchi
Finance Manager
Trento Systems
Attachment: Trento-VAT-Certificate.pdf

From: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>
To: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@trento-systems.it>
Cc: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-07T09:30:00+02:00
Subject: Re: Billing details and VAT handling for Redwood subscription

Hi Luca — thanks for the certificate, and welcome. I've looped in finance (Marcus) and billing (Priya) so we can confirm the tax treatment and get you a PDF invoice that satisfies your auditors.

Next steps I propose:
- Marcus to validate the VAT ID via VIES and confirm whether name/address match is sufficient.
- If VIES passes, we will issue an invoice net of VAT and include a reverse-charge note.
- If VIES needs supplemental documentation, we'll ask for the additional file(s) (certified copy or reseller PO).

A couple of clarifying items for the invoice: please confirm the full legal name you want on the invoice, billing address, and whether you are buying directly or through a German reseller (we sometimes see reseller arrangements that change how VAT must be handled).

Thanks — I'll kick this off internally and follow up by Friday.

Best,
Irene Choi
Account Lead, EMEA
Redwood Inference

From: Marcus Lin <marcus_lin@redwood.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.com>, Priya Natarajan <priya_natarajan@redwood.com>
Date: 2026-10-08T11:02:00+02:00
Subject: Re: VAT evidence and next steps (Trento Systems)

I ran the VAT ID through VIES this morning. The numeric ID IT01234567890 resolves but the registered name comes back as "Trento S.p.A." while the certificate Luca sent lists "Trento Systems S.r.l." — small legal-name mismatch. Screenshot attached (VIES-check-20261008.png).

Guidance:
- EU reverse-charge can still apply if the VAT ID validates and the buyer is the taxable person. However, to satisfy our audit and your procurement team, we should collect one of the following supplemental items: a company registration extract or a signed statement on company letterhead showing the VAT ID and legal name (or confirmation that the S.p.A. / S.r.l. naming difference is the same legal entity).
- If they are purchasing via a reseller (Germany), we need either a reseller invoice showing onward sale or a reseller PO naming Redwood. That changes whether we treat it as a domestic sale in DE or an intra-EU supply.

Recommendation: ask Luca for a quick registrar extract or a brief letter from their legal team confirming the exact legal name associated with the VAT number. Once we have that, we should issue an invoice with: net amount, note "VAT reverse-charge applies — recipient to self-account under Article 196 of the VAT Directive", and reference the buyer VAT ID. Do not collect VAT.

— Marcus
Finance Operations
Redwood Inference
Attachment: VIES-check-20261008.png

From: Luca Bianchi <luca.bianchi@trento-systems.it>
